name: PS5 Firmware
author: Daniel Eriksson
description: Watches the PlayStation 5 firmware manifests and speaks up only when something actually changes: a new latest version, a raised force-update minimum, a region losing coverage, or the same version rebuilt.

barWidget.description: PS5 firmware status. Left click: firmware panel. Middle click: check now.

schema.label: Check interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often the upstream manifest is read. The public API caches its own answers for 30 minutes, so checking faster than that mostly repeats the same numbers.

schema.label: Region on the bar
schema.description: GLOBAL reports the agreed figure across every region that answers. Picking a single region shows only that manifest. EU, KR, MX, TW and HK have no directly readable manifest of their own, so they are reported as an estimate.

schema.label: Your firmware
schema.description: The version your console runs, for example 13.60. Leave it empty and the panel simply asks instead of answering.

schema.label: Notify when firmware changes
schema.description: One notification, updated in place, when the latest version, the minimum, a region's coverage or the build changes.

schema.label: Notify when the source stops answering
schema.description: Only after four checks in a row fail, never on a single hiccup.

service.description: Polls the PlayStation 5 firmware manifest and writes what it sees to the plugin's state directory.
